integrity: Proof by deterministic append recurrence, polynomial transfer, conditional moments, and central limit theorem; independent finite enumeration and transfer checks are supporting corroboration, not substitutes for proof.
scientific_limitations: Uniform independent input letters; fixed alphabet size for the normal limit. The binary second moment was previously known; pairwise ball intersections and nonuniform inputs are not addressed. Some equivalent nonbinary calculation might remain unindexed.
title: Complete finite-alphabet two-deletion-sphere size law and Gaussian fluctuations
